brief:
Canada, the UK and Australia should launch independent investigations into an Israeli military strike that killed seven workers for the World Central Kitchen humanitarian organization in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. Israel has demonstrated reluctance to hold accountable those responsible for the deaths, the outlet reported.

The call for external scrutiny follows the March 2024 incident in which an Israeli airstrike targeted a convoy operated by the US-based aid group, killing staff from multiple countries. The deaths sparked international outcry and prompted WCK to suspend operations in Gaza.
dek: Israel has made clear it is unwilling to hold to account those responsible for the deaths of seven humanitarian workers.
title: Western allies should probe Israeli strike killing aid workers, Al Jazeera says
